description: This file defines internal static class NetworkingInstruments used for telemetry, specifically for tracking network socket open and close events via counters in Orleans.

classes.name: NetworkingInstruments
classes.description: A static class for telemetry instrumentation of networking events, tracking socket open/close counts.

methods.name: OnOpenedSocket
methods.description: Increments the counter for opened sockets, tagged by direction.

methods.name: OnClosedSocket
methods.description: Increments the counter for closed sockets, tagged by direction.
